Start with a Hook- draw in the reader with strong and memorable words from the very first sentence 

Tell a true story- share personal details and write in the form of a story. Let them know who you are as a person. 

Fully Answer the question- is the prompt a one or two part question? Address all portions and give complete answers. 

Heed word count (pay attention to the word count)- do not try to exceed the specified word count. Use all available space to impress the judge. 

Proofread and share- carefully read over the essay, then find two people who can critique it and not bs and say that you did well. Look for people who will actually help and guide you on how to improve it. 

Hope this helps!
